# Vendored: quoridor-ai

`game.js` and `ai.js` are copied unmodified from
[gorisanson/quoridor-ai](https://github.com/gorisanson/quoridor-ai) (`src/js/`),
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2019 Kyutae Lee — see `LICENSE` in this folder.

They are loaded only by `src/workers/analysis-worker.js`. To update, replace both files with
newer upstream versions and run `npm test`.
